_about: Pilot portraits (issue I84). Qwen-Image t2i from deterministic feature words, seed crc32(profile) + reseed. Gender and apparent age read from the original pilot photos (MCUI_High2.tga, PictureIndex) and the voice sets (pilotAudio), never their likeness; ethnicity, hair and build are chosen fresh. tools/art/portraits.py renders them.
prompt: Character portrait for a gritty science-fiction military strategy game, realistic digital painting with fine visible brushwork, in the style of modern AAA game character art. A {age} {ethnicity} {gender}, a veteran mercenary pilot, {build} build, {face}, {hair}, {expression}. Wearing a worn dark olive-grey padded flight suit with a high padded ribbed collar zipped to the throat, matte fabric, plain unmarked fabric, no helmet, no equipment on the head or neck. Tight head-and-shoulders portrait: the face is centred horizontally in the upper-middle of the frame with a little empty backdrop above the hair, the frame cut at the upper chest. Shoulders turned slightly to the left in three-quarter view, eyes looking at the viewer, 85mm portrait lens, soft neutral key light from the upper left, faint cool blue-grey rim light on the right side of the face, plain dark slate-blue studio backdrop with a soft gradient, muted desaturated colour grade, sharp focus on the eyes.
